data.body: Lane f041, 2026-10-19 10:10 PDT: CI run 39287305620 on Gerrit 3055 patch set 1 (914beb802036) concluded failure; 4 pytest cells failed, every other job passed. (a) ubuntu-latest py3.11, py3.12 and py3.13, default suite: 1 failed each (19,909-19,939 passed): tests/interfaces/contracts/test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py::test_nested_family_child_help_falls_through_to_argparse pins the literal _help_route._NESTED_INTERCEPTS set, which this change grew by 'store'. The Linux integration tier was skipped, because it runs only after the default suite passes. (b) macos-latest py3.13: 1 failed (987 passed): tests/integration/test_store_concurrency.py::test_concurrent_writer_storm_no_loss, the missed `rebar fsck --output json` call noted above. Both are fixed in the worktree: the pin gains 'store' (the file passes locally, 32 tests, including its loop over all 8 `store <sub> --help` children), and the storm test calls `store fsck` (2 tests pass). They go into patch set 2 as a WIP amend. Unverified: the Linux integration tier on this change, which runs only once the default suite is green.
